RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning your sex was not a distinguishing factor in the decision. While public universities often have internal procedural guidelines regarding gender diversity on interview panels, an all-male committee choosing one male candidate over another provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination. Raising the panel's gender composition is likely to appear unfounded and could damage your professional standing.

The announcement explicitly highlighted the selected candidate's industry experience, indicating the department prioritized specific practical expertise over publication count. Follow up politely on your written feedback request, focusing entirely on your qualifications and departmental fit rather than the panel's demographics.
